items.title_zh: 中国信通院：6 月国内词元日均消耗量约 500 万亿，是 2025 年 12 月的近 4 倍
items.title_en: CAICT: China's Daily Token Consumption Hit ~500 Trillion in June, Nearly 4x December 2025
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据中国信通院，随着大模型技术的迅速迭代，词元（Token）服务成为从技术走向应用的关键点，我国日均词元调用量持续攀升，2026 年 6 月， 国内词元日均消耗量约 500 万亿 ，是 2025 年 12 月的近 4 倍。产业中越来越多的 MaaS（Model as a Service，模型即服务）平台厂商通过公有云 API 方式供给大模型词元服务。然而用户对词元服务性能缺乏直观的判断依据，且面临选型困难等各类问题。 为有效衡量服务性能，中国信息通信研究院（简称“中国信通院”）人工智能研究所、人工智能大模型及软硬件评测工业和信息化部重点实验室和中国人工智能产业发展联盟，自 2025 年以来持续开展公有云大模型词元服务性能监测工作，为产业应用提供重要参考，现联合发布《大模型词元服务性能监测报告（2026 年）》。 报告基于 2026 年 1-8 月的监测数据，围绕各平台词元服务调用成功率、吞吐速度、首词时延、稳定性、价格、上下文窗口等维度开展分析，对比原厂大模型官方平台，以及 DeepSeek、Qwen、GLM、Kimi 四款开源模型在第三方平台上的性能差异，进一步分析影响词元服务性能的关键因素，总结产业核心观察，明确下一步工作计划，旨在为用户选型提供参考，并为产业界优化服务能力提供方向指引。 IT之家附报告核心观点： 1. 国内词元服务每秒吞吐量较…
items.summary_en: China's Academy of ICT (CAICT) says domestic daily token consumption reached about 500 trillion in June 2026, nearly four times the December 2025 level. It released a 2026 token service performance monitoring report based on January-August data, comparing official vendor platforms with third-party hosting of DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and Kimi across success rate, throughput, first-token latency, stability, price and context window.
items.why_zh: 词元消耗量是衡量大模型真实落地规模的硬指标，而性能监测报告为用户选型提供了统一参照。
items.why_en: Token consumption is a hard gauge of real-world LLM adoption, and the benchmark report gives buyers a common basis for choosing services.

items.title_zh: 智谱唐杰署名RSI新成果开源！Agent自我进化成本还狂降53%
items.title_en: Zhipu's Tang Jie Co-authors Open-Sourced RSI Work, Cutting Agent Self-Evolution Cost by 53%
items.summary_zh: 智谱唐杰署名RSI新成果开源！Agent自我进化成本还狂降53% 智源社区
items.summary_en: A new RSI-related research result co-authored by Zhipu's Tang Jie has been open-sourced, with reports saying it cuts the cost of agent self-evolution by 53%. The available summary does not detail the method, benchmarks or repository.
items.why_zh: 自我进化成本大幅下降，是智能体从实验室演示走向长期自主运行的关键一步。
items.why_en: Cheaper self-evolution is a key step toward agents that can run and improve autonomously over time.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：维持2.8万亿参数，强化后训练并提升专业任务能力
items.title_en: Moonshot Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: Keeps 2.8T Parameters, Boosts Post-Training for Professional Tasks
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：维持2.8万亿参数，强化后训练并提升专业任务能力 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, keeping the 2.8-trillion-parameter scale while strengthening post-training to improve performance on professional tasks. Specific benchmark scores were not disclosed in the available summary.
items.why_zh: 在参数规模不变的前提下靠后训练提升专业能力，反映大模型竞争正从“堆参数”转向“拼训练方法”。
items.why_en: Improving professional capability through post-training rather than scale shows the frontier shifting from parameter counts to training methodology.

items.why_zh: 高端模型同步“提能力+降价格”，会直接压缩同类模型的定价空间，加速 API 市场的价格竞争。
items.why_en: Combining capability upgrades with price cuts intensifies pricing pressure across the model API market.

items.title_zh: 中国最强开源模型杀到！Kimi K3.1 Pro剥离网络攻击数据：编程仍反超GPT-6

items.summary_en: Drivenet reports that Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro removed cyberattack-related data from training while still outperforming GPT-6 on coding evaluations. Benchmark names and score margins were not provided in the available summary.
items.why_zh: 在剔除高风险训练数据的同时保持编程能力，说明安全合规与模型性能可以不必二选一。
items.why_en: Keeping coding performance while removing risky training data suggests safety filtering and capability need not be a trade-off.

items.why_en: Generative AI is increasingly used to repackage traditional culture for younger audiences, making such campaigns a test case for cultural AI applications.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro性能媲美美国顶尖模型

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro, saying its performance rivals top US models. This aligns with other coverage describing post-training upgrades, API price cuts and comparisons to GPT-6 and Claude Opus 5.5, though no benchmark figures were given.
items.why_zh: 中国开源模型能否稳定逼近美国前沿模型，是判断全球 AI 竞争格局的关键观察点。
items.why_en: Whether Chinese open models can consistently approach US frontier models is a key signal for the global AI competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: 消息称字节跳动 AI 短剧产品内部整合：小云雀并入即梦，仍保留独立入口
items.title_en: ByteDance Merges AI Short-Drama Platform Xiaoyunque Into Jimeng, Keeping Separate Entry
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据 36 氪今日报道，字节跳动内部近期完成了一次业务整合，AI 短剧创作平台小云雀并入智能创作平台即梦，产品仍保留独立入口。 此次调整以资源整合为主，即梦已经接入小云雀的短剧相关能力。调整后，小云雀的运营由即梦运营和市场负责人陈欣然负责，产品团队没有变化。 小云雀和即梦均出自字节剪映团队。小云雀定位为一站式 AI 内容创作平台，今年 3 月上线短剧 Agent，支持上传最多 10 万字剧本、一键生成视频成片，搭载了字节自研的 Seedance 2.0 模型，在短剧、漫剧的标准化生产场景中具备从剧本解析到分镜生成的完整流程能力。 即梦 AI 于 2024 年 5 月推出，最初覆盖文生图、文生视频等生成能力，此后逐步向智能画布、首尾帧控制等偏专业创作的 Agent 编辑工具延伸，用户群体覆盖普通创作者与专业设计师。 IT之家注意到，两者在功能上存在重叠：都能在平台内完成“从生成到成片”的全流程，与剪映的剪辑环节形成平行的用户路径。
items.summary_en: ByteDance has folded its AI short-drama creation platform Xiaoyunque into its broader AI creation platform Jimeng, according to a 36Kr report, while keeping Xiaoyunque as a standalone entry point. The move is mainly a resource consolidation: Jimeng has absorbed Xiaoyunque's short-drama capabilities, and Xiaoyunque's operations now report to Jimeng's operations and marketing lead Chen Xinran, with the product team unchanged. Both products come from ByteDance's Jianying (CapCut) team and overlap in offering an end-to-end generation-to-finished-video workflow.
items.why_zh: 这显示字节跳动正在整合功能重叠的AI视频创作产品，以应对AI短剧这一快速升温的生成式内容赛道。
items.why_en: It shows ByteDance consolidating overlapping AI video-creation products as competition in AI-generated short dramas heats up.

items.why_zh: 开源模型的代际更新会直接影响开发者可选的技术方案与开源与闭源模型之间的竞争格局。
items.why_en: A new generation of an open-source model reshapes the options available to developers and the open-versus-closed model competition.

items.title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi K3.1 Pro Open-Source Model

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that Moonshot AI has launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a new open-source iteration in its Kimi model line. The report does not include parameter counts, context length or benchmark figures.
items.why_zh: 国内头部厂商继续以开源方式发布新模型，反映出开源路线在大模型竞争中的地位仍在上升。
items.why_en: A leading Chinese lab continuing to ship open-source models signals the rising importance of open releases in the LLM race.

items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro模型发布：3万亿级参数，支持100万上下文

items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro模型发布：3万亿级参数，支持100万上下文 风闻
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro features 3-trillion-scale parameters and supports a 1-million-token context window, according to Fengwen. The report does not clarify whether the figure refers to total or active parameters, nor does it provide benchmark scores.
items.why_zh: 超大参数规模与百万级上下文是当前大模型能力竞争的两个关键指标，直接影响可处理任务的复杂度。
items.why_en: Huge parameter counts and million-token context windows are key battlegrounds that directly determine how complex a task a model can handle.

items.title_zh: 全球参数规模最大的开源模型再突破！月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.title_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro Pushes the Frontier of the Largest Open-Source Models
items.summary_zh: 全球参数规模最大的开源模型再突破！月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro ThePaper.cn
items.summary_en: The Paper reports that Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, framing it as a further advance for the world's largest open-source models by parameter scale. The report emphasizes its scale leadership without listing detailed specifications or benchmark results.
items.why_zh: 超大参数开源模型的持续迭代，正在改变开源模型只能追随闭源模型能力上限的固有印象。
items.why_en: Ever-larger open-source models are challenging the assumption that open releases must trail closed models in capability.

items.title_zh: 中国月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro模型，称代码、金融研究等能力提升尤为显著
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro, Citing Notable Gains in Coding and Financial Research
items.summary_zh: 中国月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro模型，称代码、金融研究等能力提升尤为显著 TradingView
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI says Kimi K3.1 Pro delivers notably improved capabilities in coding and financial research, according to TradingView. No specific benchmark scores were disclosed in the report.
items.why_zh: 代码与金融研究是当前大模型商业化落地最具价值的场景之一，能力提升直接关系到专业用户的采用意愿。
items.why_en: Coding and financial research are among the most commercially valuable LLM use cases, so capability gains directly affect professional adoption.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万Token上下文，剑指最强闭源模型
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro: 3 Trillion Parameters, 1M-Token Context, Aiming at Top Closed Models
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万Token上下文，剑指最强闭源模型 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports that Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro comes with 3 trillion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, positioning it as an open model aimed at rivaling the strongest closed-source systems. Beyond those two figures, no further technical details were provided.
items.why_zh: 开源模型公开对标顶级闭源模型，会加剧开源与闭源两条路线的正面竞争。
items.why_en: An open model openly targeting top closed systems intensifies direct competition between the open and closed camps.

items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro发布：多项测试超越GPT-6，最强开源模型回归
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tops GPT-6 on Several Benchmarks as the Strongest Open Model Returns
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro发布：多项测试超越GPT-6，最强开源模型回归 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports that Kimi K3.1 Pro outperforms GPT-6 on several benchmarks, describing it as the return of the strongest open-source model. The report does not list individual benchmark names or scores.
items.why_zh: 若开源模型在公开评测中确实超越顶级闭源模型，将显著影响企业对模型选型与成本结构的判断。
items.why_en: If an open model genuinely beats a top closed model on public benchmarks, it would significantly shift enterprise decisions on model choice and cost.

items.title_zh: iPhone Duo正式交付；Kimi K3.1 Pro 、Seedance 2.5 4K正式发布；红果短剧上线防沉迷｜极客早知道
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Ships, Kimi K3.1 Pro and Seedance 2.5 4K Launch on the Same Day
items.summary_zh: iPhone Duo正式交付；Kimi K3.1 Pro 、Seedance 2.5 4K正式发布；红果短剧上线防沉迷｜极客早知道 极客公园

The briefing bundles hardware, foundation-model and content-platform updates from a single day.
items.why_zh: 一天之内硬件交付、大模型与视频生成模型更新、平台合规措施同时落地，是观察 AI 产品化节奏的窗口。
items.why_en: Simultaneous hardware shipping, model releases and platform compliance moves in one day offer a snapshot of how fast AI is being productized.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布最强模型Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿级参数、100万Token上下文
items.title_en: Moonshot Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro with Trillion-Scale Parameters and 1M-Token Context
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布最强模型Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿级参数、100万Token上下文 驱动之家
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro, its most powerful model to date, featuring parameters at the 3-trillion scale and a 1-million-token context window. The release pushes both model scale and long-context capability to a new level among Chinese foundation models.
items.why_zh: 3 万亿级参数与百万级上下文同时落地，标志着国产大模型在规模与长文本处理上的竞争进入新阶段。
items.why_en: Trillion-scale parameters paired with a million-token context mark a new phase in the scale and long-context race among Chinese model developers.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro 3万亿级参数模型
items.title_en: Moonshot Unveils Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3-Trillion-Parameter Model
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro 3万亿级参数模型 新浪网
items.summary_en: Sina reports that Moonshot AI officially launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, a model with parameters in the 3-trillion range and the largest version the company has released. The report focuses on the jump in scale, without detailing benchmark results or pricing.
items.why_zh: 参数规模再上台阶，说明头部厂商仍在用“更大模型”作为能力竞争的主要路径。
items.why_en: Another jump in parameter count shows leading labs still treat bigger models as a primary route to capability gains.

items.why_zh: 重量级模型承诺开源权重，会直接影响开发者生态与闭源模型的竞争格局。
items.why_en: A heavyweight model pledging open weights directly shapes the developer ecosystem and the competitive balance with closed models.

items.why_en: A model developer deploying capital into robotics and embodied AI signals that combining models with physical systems is the next battleground.

items.why_zh: 同周内出现开源推理框架、IPO 破发与个人助手新品，集中体现了 AI 行业技术、资本与产品三条线的冷热不均。

items.title_zh: 小米 REDMI Book 2027 预热：外观焕新，16 英寸机型标配数字小键盘

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小米 REDMI Book 2027 系列笔记本已经官宣将于 10 月 27 日发布。这款笔记本搭载第三代英特尔酷睿平台，内置 72Wh 电池，提供多彩配色，质感全面升级，主打移动办公。 小米产品行销总监、数码博主马志宇表示，REDMI Book 16 2027 在外观焕新的同时，还将加入用户长期反复提及的诉求 —— 数字小键盘。 当然，对于 16 英寸笔记本而言，数字小键盘并非技术难题，也不能严格称为优点或缺点，更多是产品定义上的取舍。 结合此前爆料，REDMI Book 16 2027 将搭载酷睿 5 320 处理器，并配备可自主更换的 DDR5 内存，不再延续前代内存板载的设计。 其他已确认或接近确认的信息包括：14 英寸版本采用 2.8K 分辨率屏幕，保留双 USB-A、双 USB-C、HDMI 和 3.5mm 耳机接口；全系内置超级小爱 2.0，支持跨设备协同和 AI 办公辅助。16 英寸版本的散热据爆料将升级为双风扇加 10mm 热管。 作为参考，2026 款 REDMI Book 14 的起售价为 6499 元（IT之家注：16GB+512GB），首销价曾下探至 5499 元，部分渠道在叠加国补后甚至达到了 4800 元区间。 相关阅读： 《 小米 REDMI Book 14 2027 笔记本“星云紫”亮相，10 月 27 日发布 》…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi will launch the REDMI Book 2027 series on October 27, featuring third-generation Intel Core platforms, a 72Wh battery and new colors. The 16-inch model adds a numeric keypad, reportedly pairs a Core 5 320 with replaceable DDR5 memory and dual-fan cooling, while the 14-inch version offers a 2.8K display; both include Super XiaoAi 2.0 for cross-device and AI office features.

items.title_zh: 研究人员通过 DNS 数据库发现数千个公开的 Muse 聊天记录分享链接，Meta 已修复
items.title_en: Thousands of Shared Muse Chat Links Were Discoverable via DNS, Meta Says It Fixed the Issue
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，Meta 旗下个人 AI 助手 Muse 的对话分享功能被曝存在隐私风险。 网络安全研究团队 Claroc 于 10 月 18 日发布报告称，研究人员通过被动 DNS（Passive DNS）查询发现，超过 6800 个 Muse 分享页面的域名可以被检索到，部分页面包含个人财务资料、企业内部文件及机密会议准备信息。Meta 随后暂停了该功能，并表示正在调查问题及评估改进方案。 Claroc 研究团队发现，Muse 会根据用户分享的对话标题生成网页地址，并将其部署在 cf.metaaiusercontent.com 域名下。由于对话标题被写入子域名，当用户或接收者访问分享页面时，相关域名可能被被动 DNS 服务记录，进而出现在可查询的历史 DNS 数据库中。 研究人员表示，通过一次被动 DNS 查询，他们便发现了超过 6800 个分享页面的主机名。Claroc 随后抽查了数百个页面，发现其中部分内容涉及企业营收审查文件、小企业贷款申请、银行欺诈警报、房地产投资数据，以及员工年度休假安排等敏感信息。研究人员还发现，一名候选人为与一家前沿 AI 实验室负责人进行机密电话沟通准备的材料，其中包含内部联系人信息和会议时间。 Claroc 指出，相关页面无需登录 Meta 账号即可访问，只要能够获得对应链接即可查看内容。问题并非源于攻击者破解了随机生成的标识…
items.summary_en: Security researchers at Claroc found that more than 6,800 shared Muse conversation pages could be discovered through passive DNS lookups, because share links were built from conversation titles as subdomains. Sampled pages contained corporate revenue reviews, loan applications, fraud alerts and other sensitive material, accessible without logging in. Meta paused the feature and said it is investigating.
items.why_zh: AI 助手的分享功能若设计不当，可能把私密对话变成可被搜索的公开数据。
items.why_en: Poorly designed AI sharing features can turn private conversations into publicly discoverable data.

items.title_en: BYD Establishes Hong Kong Smart Transportation Subsidiary, Plans to Introduce SkyShuttle

items.summary_en: BYD announced the establishment of BYD Smart Transportation (Hong Kong) Ltd. in Hong Kong, based at the Science Park in Pak Shek Kok, to promote its SkyShuttle rail system. SkyShuttle is a low-capacity, elevated, autonomous transit system designed for hilly terrain, with a maximum speed of 80 km/h and capacity of up to 560 passengers per train. The move responds to Hong Kong’s push for smart green mass transit.

items.why_en: BYD is entering Hong Kong public transit with SkyShuttle, offering a new low-capacity rail option for dense, hilly cities.

items.title_en: CAICT: About 15 million passenger cars in China had NOA as of August
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，据中国信通院，2026 世界智能网联汽车大会已于 10 月 21 日至 23 日在北京亦庄举办。在全体大会成果发布环节，工业和信息化部装备工业一司司长郭守刚介绍了国家车联网技术标准体系与 跨标委 合作机制，发布《国家车联网技术标准体系建设指南（2026 版）》（征求意见稿），并主持车联网标准跨标委合作协议签署仪式。 会上介绍，中国先后制定发布组合驾驶辅助系统、自动驾驶系统、自动紧急制动系统、整车信息安全等多项重要国家标准。截至今年 8 月，国内约 6100 万辆乘用车搭载组合驾驶辅助（L2）功能， 其中约 1500 万辆乘用车具备领航驾驶辅助（ NOA ）功能 。 IT之家从公告获悉，目前，中国已制定发布 C-V2X 直连通信与 5G 蜂窝通信技术系列标准，并依托“四跨”等应用实践活动，合力推动网联通信应用走向规模化。截至今年 8 月， 约 1600 万辆乘用车装配 5G 终端 、200 万辆乘用车装配 C-V2X 终端。 会上提到，道路交通系统是智能网联汽车的运行载体。智能交通、车辆智能管理领域一批支撑标准的陆续发布，有力支撑了高速公路、城市道路等路侧基础设施智能化改造、网联化升级，开展道路通行规定符合性测试，提升车路协同服务和交通管理能力。 此外，车联网平台汇聚车、路、云产业链多方主体。车联网平台技术要求及平台安全等标准的发布与实施，为支撑智能…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Intelligent Connected Vehicle Conference, MIIT released a draft national vehicle networking standards guide and signed cross-committee cooperation agreements. As of August, about 61 million passenger cars in China had L2 combined driving assistance, including about 15 million with NOA; about 16 million had 5G terminals and 2 million had C-V2X terminals. China has issued standards covering driver assistance, autonomous driving, automatic emergency braking, vehicle cybersecurity, C-V2X and 5G communications.
items.why_zh: 显示中国智能驾驶与车联网功能正规模化渗透，也为标准制定和产业化提供依据。
items.why_en: It shows the large-scale adoption of smart driving and connected-car features in China, supporting standards and industrialization.

items.title_zh: 倍思为苹果 iPhone Duo 推出卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源：7.5W 无线 +25W 有线，5000mAh 售 374 元
items.title_en: Baseus launches card magnetic Air power bank for iPhone Duo at ¥374
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，倍思现已在京东上架一款卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源，该产品最大的特点是适配了苹果 iPhone Duo 尺寸，其内置 5000mAh 电芯，定价为 374 元。 京东 倍思卡片磁吸 Air 移动电源 券后 374 元 点此访问 该机尺寸为 85x81x7.9mm，整体重量 120g，支持 7.5W 无线输出和 25W USB-C 有线输出，电芯通过新国标认证，可通过手机 NFC 查看电芯健康度信息。 IT之家附产品参数： 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次： 点此抽红包 。
items.summary_en: Baseus has listed a card-style magnetic Air power bank on JD.com, designed to fit the Apple iPhone Duo size. It has a 5,000mAh cell, measures 85x81x7.9mm, weighs 120g, supports 7.5W wireless and 25W USB-C wired output, and costs ¥374. The cell passes China's new national standard and supports NFC battery-health checks.
items.why_zh: 反映配件厂商针对iPhone新尺寸快速适配，以及磁吸无线充电配件的持续升温。
items.why_en: It reflects accessory makers' rapid adaptation to new iPhone sizes and the growing magnetic wireless charging market.

items.title_zh: 多个App拒绝豆包手机助手 金融机构对外部智能体说“不”
items.title_en: Multiple apps reject Doubao phone assistant as financial institutions say no to external agents
items.summary_zh: 多个App拒绝豆包手机助手 金融机构对外部智能体说“不” 21财经
items.summary_en: According to 21 Finance, multiple apps have rejected the Doubao phone assistant, and financial institutions are saying no to external AI agents. The report points to resistance when phone AI assistants try to operate across apps or enter financial scenarios. The case highlights permission, security and compliance barriers facing external agents in existing app ecosystems.
items.why_zh: 手机AI助手跨App执行任务正遭遇生态壁垒与金融机构的合规审慎。
items.why_en: Phone AI assistants face ecosystem barriers and compliance caution from financial institutions when operating across apps.

items.title_zh: 密歇根大学一讲师试用AI后决定禁用
items.title_en: This University of Michigan instructor experimented with AI. Now she bans it.
items.summary_zh: MLive报道称，密歇根大学一名讲师曾尝试在教学中使用AI，如今选择禁止AI。该案例显示，部分高校教师对AI的态度正从试验转向谨慎甚至禁用。报道摘要未披露其禁用范围、课程安排及具体理由。
items.summary_en: This University of Michigan instructor experimented with AI. Now she bans it. MLive.com
items.why_zh: 折射高校课堂对AI工具的态度从试验走向谨慎与政策收紧。
items.why_en: It reflects a shift in college classrooms from experimenting with AI tools to caution and tighter policies.

items.title_zh: 【视频】11万级拿下豆包座舱助手，荣威家越07，限时权益价11.98万元起
items.title_en: Roewe Jiaoyue 07 offers Doubao cockpit assistant from ¥119,800 limited-time price
items.summary_zh: 【视频】11万级拿下豆包座舱助手，荣威家越07，限时权益价11.98万元起 汽车之家
items.summary_en: A Autohome video reports that the Roewe Jiaoyue 07 offers the Doubao cockpit assistant in the roughly ¥110,000 class, with a limited-time price starting at ¥119,800. The video highlights the model's smart cockpit features and pricing benefits. It signals that AI cockpit assistants are moving into more mainstream-priced vehicles.
items.why_zh: AI座舱助手进入11万元级车型，有助于推动智能座舱功能普及。
items.why_en: AI cockpit assistants reaching the ¥110,000 segment could help popularize smart cockpit features.

items.title_zh: Oracle承诺投入10亿美元支持合作伙伴AI增长
items.title_en: Oracle (ORCL) Commits $1 Billion To Partner AI Growth
items.summary_zh: Yahoo Finance报道，Oracle（ORCL）承诺投入10亿美元，用于支持合作伙伴的AI增长。该举措显示Oracle正通过生态合作伙伴扩大AI相关业务布局。报道摘要未披露资金的具体分配方式、时间表和受益伙伴范围。
items.summary_en: Oracle (ORCL) Commits $1 Billion To Partner AI Growth Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 云与AI竞争正延伸到对合作伙伴生态的巨额投入。
items.why_en: Cloud and AI competition is extending into major investment in partner ecosystems.

items.title_zh: 开发者成功为小米 8 手机刷入苹果 iOS 16.5 系统，将机型伪装为 iPhone X
items.title_en: Developer installs iOS 16.5 on Xiaomi 8, spoofs it as iPhone X
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，随着 AI 技术突飞猛进，许多开发者在大模型辅助加持之下对各种老旧机型进行折腾，先前便有 开发者为小米 Redmi Note 12 4G 手机刷入 iOS 系统，并开源了项目 。 IT之家注意到，目前又有开发者 Yanei 发布视频，展示其成功为一部小米 8 手机刷入 iOS 16.5 系统，参考其发布的视频，可以看到该开发者将设备机型伪装为 iPhone X，系统元素在小米 8 手机上呈现良好。 该网友在视频简介和评论区中表示，小米 8 和当年的 iPhone X 真的太像了，运行起来颇有当年的感觉，最初 GPU 存在卡顿情况，后续经过修复后流畅了不少。 目前，系统桌面显示和动画已经比较流畅，不过项目整体仍处于早期移植阶段，很多硬件驱动还需要继续适配，暂时不能作为日常系统使用。 公开信息显示，小米 8 于 2018 年 5 月 31 日推出，该机采用 6.21 英寸三星 AMOLED 异型全面屏（刘海屏），机身背部采用四曲面玻璃设计，配合 7 系铝金属中框，搭载了高通骁龙 845 移动平台，内置 3400mAh 电池。
items.summary_en: Developer Yanei has posted a video showing iOS 16.5 running on a Xiaomi 8, with the device spoofed as an iPhone X. The developer says initial GPU stutter was largely fixed and the home screen and animations are now fairly smooth, but the project remains an early port with many hardware drivers still needing work and is not ready for daily use. The Xiaomi 8 launched in May 2018 with a 6.21-inch AMOLED notch display, Snapdragon 845 and 3,400mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 体现开发者社区对跨系统移植的持续探索，也提示早期移植在驱动与稳定性上的挑战。
items.why_en: It shows ongoing community efforts in cross-platform OS porting and the driver and stability challenges of early builds.

items.title_zh: 小鹏汽车官宣在欧洲四国实现累计销量破万，覆盖丹麦、挪威、法国、德国
items.title_en: XPeng Hits 10,000 Cumulative Sales in Four European Countries, With G6 and G9 Topping Local Segments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，小鹏汽车官方昨日宣布，在欧洲四国（丹麦、挪威、法国、德国）实现了累计销量破万， 同时小鹏 G6 和 G9 也多次获得了当地销量第一 。 据IT之家此前报道，在小鹏 G9L 巴黎车展全球上市发布会上，小鹏集团董事长、CEO 何小鹏表示，2026 年上半年，小鹏在法国的销量位居中国新势力品牌第一。何小鹏还表示， 目标是到 2030 年底全球年销量达到 100 万辆，其中欧洲占一半 。 值得一提的是，欧洲本地首台小鹏 G9L 已于 10 月 7 日在麦格纳奥地利工厂顺利完成试制。小鹏集团还当选了联合国欧洲经济委员会（UNECE）GRVA / WP.29 框架下，新设的“自动驾驶场景相关信息交换工作组”（TF-ESRI）秘书长。 这也是中国企业首次在联合国自动驾驶法规核心框架下担任秘书长 。 延伸阅读 据小鹏汽车公布的细分市场数据，小鹏 G6 在丹麦成为 2026 年中国纯电车型销量第一，在法国、德国获得 2026 年第三季度中国新势力纯电中型 SUV 销量榜首；小鹏 G9 则在挪威获得 2026 年中国新势力纯电中大型 SUV 销量第一。 小鹏汽车的出海布局最早自挪威开启，目前海外市场业务已扩展至数十个国家和地区。官方数据显示，其海外累计交付量已超过 10 万台，其中欧洲市场贡献约 60% 的份额；2026 年第二季度海外单季销量首次突破 2 万台，同比…
items.summary_en: XPeng said cumulative sales in Denmark, Norway, France and Germany have passed 10,000 units, with the G6 and G9 repeatedly ranking first in local segments. The company says overseas deliveries now exceed 100,000 units, about 60% of them in Europe, and that a locally built G9L completed a trial build at Magna's Austrian plant.
items.why_zh: 这是中国新势力车企在欧洲从“试水”走向规模化的重要信号，也关系到其本地化生产与全球百万销量目标的落地。
items.why_en: It signals that a Chinese EV startup is moving from testing the waters to real scale in Europe, a key step toward its local production plans and global sales goals.

items.title_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy接入Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万上下文
items.title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy Integrates Kimi K3.1 Pro With 3 Trillion Parameters and 1M Context
items.summary_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy接入Kimi K3.1 Pro：3万亿参数、100万上下文 凤凰网
items.summary_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy has integrated Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro, a model with roughly 3 trillion parameters and a 1-million-token context window, according to ifeng. The move gives WorkBuddy users access to a domestic model designed for very long documents and complex tasks.
items.why_zh: 头部互联网产品接入超大参数、超长上下文国产模型，说明国内大模型竞争正从“发榜”转向真实产品与工作流落地。
items.why_en: A major internet product adopting a huge-context domestic model shows China's LLM race shifting from benchmark releases to real product and workflow deployment.

items.title_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy正式接入Kimi K3.1 Pro，同步上线高速版模型
items.title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy Officially Adopts Kimi K3.1 Pro, Adds High-Speed Model Variant
items.summary_zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy正式接入Kimi K3.1 Pro，同步上线高速版模型 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Tencent WorkBuddy has officially integrated Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro and launched a high-speed variant of the model alongside it, according to Sohu. The pairing lets users choose between stronger reasoning and faster responses depending on the task.
items.why_zh: 同时提供“旗舰版+高速版”的双模型配置，反映出 AI 产品在能力与成本、延迟之间做工程化取舍的普遍趋势。
items.why_en: Offering both a flagship and a high-speed model reflects the broader industry trade-off between capability, cost and latency in AI products.

items.title_zh: 3万亿级参数规模 全球最大开源AI大模型上新
items.title_en: World's Largest Open-Source AI Model, at 3-Trillion-Parameter Scale, Gets an Update
items.summary_zh: 3万亿级参数规模 全球最大开源AI大模型上新 中国新闻网
items.summary_en: China News Service reports a new release of an open-source AI model at the 3-trillion-parameter scale, described as the largest open-source model update globally. Such scale typically brings stronger general capability but also higher inference and deployment costs.
items.why_zh: 开源模型参数规模跃升到 3 万亿级，将直接影响企业自建与二次开发的门槛与选择。
items.why_en: Pushing open-source models to the 3-trillion-parameter scale directly affects the cost and options for companies building on or self-hosting them.

items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1发布，实力大幅进步，终结中国大模型数月“空窗期”
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Launches With Big Gains, Ending Months-Long Lull for Chinese LLMs
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3.1发布，实力大幅进步，终结中国大模型数月“空窗期” 风闻
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 release marks a notable capability jump and is seen as ending a months-long quiet stretch in China's large-model field, according to Fengwen. The report frames it as reigniting competition among domestic model makers.
items.why_zh: 在经历一段发布低谷后，头部模型的迭代节奏恢复，会重新影响开发者与企业的模型选型。
items.why_en: After a quiet stretch, renewed iteration from a leading Chinese lab reshapes how developers and enterprises choose their models.

items.title_zh: #生活# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash登顶Code Arena开源模型榜单
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Tops Code Arena Open-Source Model Leaderboard
items.summary_zh: #生活# DeepSeek V4.1 Flash登顶Code Arena开源模型榜单 搜狐网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has taken first place on Code Arena's open-source model leaderboard, according to Sohu. The ranking reflects head-to-head performance on coding tasks against other open-source models.
items.why_zh: 代码能力是当前大模型最核心的落地场景之一，开源榜单排名会直接影响开发者的工具选择。
items.why_en: Coding is one of the most important real-world uses of LLMs, so open-source leaderboard standings directly influence developers' tooling choices.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布新一代大模型Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Releases Next-Generation Kimi K3.1 Pro Model
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布新一代大模型Kimi K3.1 Pro 新京报
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has officially released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a next-generation upgrade to its Kimi model line positioned as a general-purpose flagship. Details on parameters and benchmarks were not spelled out in the report.
items.why_zh: Kimi 是国产大模型的代表性产品之一，其代际更新会牵动国内 API 与消费级 AI 应用的格局。
items.why_en: Kimi is one of China's flagship model families, so a generational update ripples through domestic API offerings and consumer AI apps.

items.title_zh: 智能、便宜、能打，月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.title_en: Smart, Cheap and Competitive: Moonshot AI Ships Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary_zh: 智能、便宜、能打，月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1 Pro 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Sohu characterizes Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro as smart, inexpensive and competitive, emphasizing strong capability at low cost for developers and enterprises. Specific pricing and benchmark figures were not provided.
items.why_zh: 价格与能力的组合往往比单纯刷榜更能决定模型的实际采用率，低价高性能会加剧国内 API 市场的价格竞争。
items.why_en: Capability plus pricing often determines real adoption more than benchmarks, and a cheap-but-strong model intensifies price competition in China's API market.

items.title_zh: Kimi最强3万亿级模型来了！编程智能体测评超过GPT-6，3D建模与金融能力升级，11月4日前开放权重
items.title_en: Kimi launches 3-trillion-parameter model, tops GPT-6 in coding-agent tests
items.summary_zh: Kimi最强3万亿级模型来了！编程智能体测评超过GPT-6，3D建模与金融能力升级，11月4日前开放权重 新浪网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has released its most powerful Kimi model with 3 trillion parameters, claiming it outperforms GPT-6 in coding-agent evaluations and brings upgrades in 3D modeling and finance. The weights are set to be opened before November 4.
items.why_zh: 3万亿级参数与开放权重策略，可能加剧国产大模型在智能体与开源生态上的竞争。
items.why_en: A 3T-parameter model with open weights could intensify competition in agentic AI and China's open-model ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 3万亿级参数！Kimi K3.1空降国产第一，1/5价格狙击Astra，实测跑通3D建模
items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 debuts with 3T parameters, claims top domestic ranking at one-fifth Astra's price
items.summary_zh: 3万亿级参数！Kimi K3.1空降国产第一，1/5价格狙击Astra，实测跑通3D建模 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Kimi K3.1 has arrived with 3 trillion parameters, with reports calling it China's top model and pricing it at roughly one-fifth of Astra. Tests reportedly show it can complete 3D modeling tasks.
items.why_zh: 以低价高性能冲击旗舰市场，尤其影响3D建模等高算力应用的成本结构。
items.why_en: High performance at a much lower price could pressure rival flagship models, especially for compute-heavy tasks such as 3D modeling.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布旗舰Kimi K3.1 Pro，参数规模达3万亿
items.title_en: Moonshot AI launches new flagship Kim K3.1 Pro model with 3T parameters
items.summary_zh: SiliconANGLE报道，月之暗面推出新旗舰模型Kimi K3.1 Pro，参数规模达到3万亿。该发布将Kimi系列推向更大参数规模，定位旗舰级能力。外媒关注其与同类前沿模型的竞争。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI launches new flagship Kim K3.1 Pro model with 3T parameters SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 旗舰模型进入3万亿参数级别，显示前沿模型规模竞赛仍在持续。
items.why_en: A flagship model at the 3T-parameter scale shows the frontier model size race is still ongoing.

items.title_zh: 国产大模型上新！月之暗面推出Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.title_en: China's model lineup expands as Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary_zh: 国产大模型上新！月之暗面推出Kimi K3.1 Pro 大河财立方
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has launched Kimi K3.1 Pro, adding another flagship model to China's large-model lineup. The report frames it as part of continued domestic model updates.
items.why_zh: 国产旗舰模型持续迭代，反映国内大模型市场竞争仍保持高频。
items.why_en: Continued flagship launches show China's large-model market remains highly competitive.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1Pro和K3.1ProHighspeed_股市直击
items.title_en: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3.1Pro和K3.1ProHighspeed_股市直击 证券之星
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed variant. The dual release suggests it is targeting both flagship capability and lower-latency use cases.
items.why_zh: 同一模型推出高速版本，反映大模型竞争正从参数规模延伸到推理效率与用户体验。
items.why_en: A Highspeed variant shows competition is moving beyond parameter count toward inference efficiency and user experience.

items.title_zh: 全球最大开源模型上新了，月之暗面开源大模型新突破
items.title_en: Moonshot AI updates what it calls the world's largest open model
items.summary_zh: 全球最大开源模型上新了，月之暗面开源大模型新突破 京报网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has announced a new breakthrough in its open-source large model, described as the world's largest open model update. The report highlights continued investment in open-weight models but gives no specific parameter or benchmark details in the summary.
items.why_zh: 若属实，全球最大开源模型迭代将影响开源生态与闭源旗舰的竞争格局。
items.why_en: If confirmed, updating the world's largest open model could reshape competition between open-source and closed flagship models.

items.title_zh: Google更新隐私政策：个性化AI功能或让Gmail、Photos数据用于广告
items.title_en: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
items.summary_zh: Google更新隐私政策，为“不将Drive、Gmail、Google Photos数据用于个性化广告”的承诺增加了例外条款。Android Authority发现，10月16日起政策新增表述：除非用户选择将这些服务的数据提供给支持个性化广告的其他Google服务。这意味着使用个性化AI功能并授权数据打通的部分用户，可能看到基于其个人数据投放的广告。政策变化引发对AI功能与广告边界、用户知情同意的关注。
items.summary_en: Google has updated its privacy policy in a way that could mean you'll start seeing targeted ads based on your personal data if you're using personalized AI features. The update, spotted by Android Authority , adds an exception to its promise about not using your Drive, Gmail, or Google Photos for personalized ads. While the previous version simply said it wouldn't do that, as of October 16th, Google has added the line, "unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads." That means anyone who has connected their Drive, Gmail, or…
items.why_zh: AI个性化功能与广告数据打通，可能模糊用户对隐私承诺的预期，影响知情同意。
items.why_en: The change could blur the line between personalized AI features and ad targeting, raising consent and privacy-expectation concerns.

items.title_zh: 信通院人工智能研究所联合中国人工智能产业发展联盟发布大模型词元服务报告
items.title_en: CAICT and AIIA release report on large-model token services
items.summary_zh: 信通院人工智能研究所联合中国人工智能产业发展联盟发布大模型词元服务报告 观点网
items.summary_en: The AI Research Institute of CAICT, together with the China Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance (AIIA), has released a report on large-model token services. The report focuses on the token-based service model for large models, though the summary does not disclose specific findings.
items.why_zh: 词元服务是大模型商业化计费的关键环节，报告有助于行业形成共识与规范。
items.why_en: Token services are central to monetizing large models, so the report could help shape industry standards and norms.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek之后，StartLux再来：开源首个决策模型推理引擎，推理快至5.3倍
items.title_en: StartLux Open-Sources First Inference Engine for Decision Models, Up to 5.3x Faster
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek之后，StartLux再来：开源首个决策模型推理引擎，推理快至5.3倍 智东西
items.summary_en: StartLux has open-sourced what it describes as the first inference engine purpose-built for decision models, claiming inference speeds of up to 5.3x faster. Details on architecture, supported models and benchmarks were not disclosed in the report.
items.why_zh: 决策模型的推理效率是其落地业务系统的关键瓶颈，开源的专用推理引擎有望降低部署成本。
items.why_en: Inference efficiency is a key bottleneck for deploying decision models, and an open-source dedicated engine could lower deployment costs.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek与MiniMax已履行出口前登记 完成开源和海外授权使用
items.title_en: DeepSeek and MiniMax Complete Pre-Export Registration for Open-Source and Overseas Licensing
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek与MiniMax已履行出口前登记 完成开源和海外授权使用 观点网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek and MiniMax have completed pre-export registration covering open-source releases and overseas licensing, according to a report. The report did not detail the regulatory basis or scope of the filings.
items.why_zh: 头部大模型厂商完成出口前登记，为国内 AI 开源与海外授权提供了合规操作样本。
items.why_en: Leading Chinese model makers completing pre-export registration offers a compliance template for open-source releases and overseas licensing.

items.title_zh: HKEX launches AI and semiconductor indexes, licenses AI index in China
items.title_en: HKEX Launches AI and Semiconductor Indexes, Licenses AI Index in Mainland China
items.summary_zh: HKEX launches AI and semiconductor indexes, licenses AI index in China Reuters
items.summary_en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has launched AI and semiconductor indexes and licensed an AI index for use in mainland China, Reuters reported. Index constituents and methodology were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 新指数为 AI 与半导体产业链提供了指数化投资工具，也强化了港交所的连接平台定位。
items.why_en: The new indexes give investors AI and chip-sector exposure tools while reinforcing HKEX's role as a capital connector.

items.title_zh: 周鸿祎谈DeepSeek开源：AI时代需要“主权AI”
items.title_en: Zhou Hongyi on DeepSeek's Open Source: the AI Era Needs 'Sovereign AI'
items.summary_zh: 周鸿祎谈DeepSeek开源：AI时代需要“主权AI” zqrb.cn
items.summary_en: Zhou Hongyi, founder of 360, said DeepSeek's open-source release shows the AI era requires 'sovereign AI,' arguing that open models let organizations control their own capabilities and data.
items.why_zh: “主权 AI”主张折射出企业与大模型自主可控需求的上升，也凸显开源模型在产业落地中的战略价值。
items.why_en: The 'sovereign AI' argument reflects rising demand for self-controlled AI stacks and highlights open models' strategic value.

items.title_zh: 周鸿祎谈DeepSeek开源：AI时代，企业要有自己的“主权AI”
items.title_en: Zhou Hongyi: Enterprises Need Their Own 'Sovereign AI' in the AI Era
items.summary_zh: 周鸿祎谈DeepSeek开源：AI时代，企业要有自己的“主权AI” 川观新闻
items.summary_en: Zhou Hongyi said enterprises should build their own 'sovereign AI,' meaning control over models, data and deployment rather than fully outsourcing key capabilities.
items.why_zh: 企业级 AI 的竞争焦点正从“用哪个模型”转向“能否自主掌控模型与数据”。
items.why_en: Enterprise AI competition is shifting from which model to use toward who controls the models and data.

items.title_zh: 周鸿祎：DeepSeek开源说明AI进入主权之争
items.title_en: Zhou Hongyi: DeepSeek's Open Source Shows AI Has Entered a Contest Over Sovereignty
items.summary_zh: 周鸿祎：DeepSeek开源说明AI进入主权之争 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhou Hongyi said DeepSeek's open-source move signals AI has entered a contest over sovereignty, as open models let countries and companies build independent AI capabilities.
items.why_zh: 开源模型正在把 AI 竞争从单一厂商的技术比拼，扩展为产业与治理层面的能力自主问题。
items.why_en: Open models are widening AI competition from vendor capability to questions of industrial and governance autonomy.

items.title_zh: Canva 推出首个自研 AI 图像模型：先生成设计方案，再生成图像
items.title_en: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
items.summary_zh: Canva 发布首个自研图像生成模型 Canva Craft，直接对标 OpenAI、微软与 Google 的相关产品。该模型采用两阶段架构，先生成设计方案再生成图像，官方称这带来“更高的精确度、一致性与可控性”。Canva Craft 最高可生成 2K 分辨率图像，并支持 30 多种画幅比例。除社交媒体配图与营销素材外，它还被定位为可生成写实场景、数字艺术与环境类图像。
items.summary_en: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. The model, called Canva Craft , uses a two-stage architecture that allows it to plan a design before generating an image, allowing for "greater precision, consistency and control," according to an announcement on Thursday . Canva Craft can generate images at up to 2K resolution and in more than 30 aspect ratios. In addition to generating social media posts and marketing content, it's also supposed to create realistic scenes, digital art, environ…
items.why_zh: 设计平台自研模型并采用“先规划后生成”的架构，是图像生成走向可控化、生产级应用的一个信号。
items.why_en: A design platform building its own plan-then-generate model signals image generation moving toward controllable, production-grade use.

items.title_zh: 如何设计一套可持续演进的 AI 服务推理框架
items.title_en: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，企业 AI 的下一个竞争优势，与其说取决于选择哪个模型，不如说取决于围绕模型构建了什么。过去几年行业焦点集中在模型能力——更大的模型、更强的推理、更长的上下文窗口和更高的基准分数，这些进步固然显著。但随着 AI 从实验走向生产，企业面临的问题已从“模型能做什么”转变为“能否可靠、经济且大规模地交付这种智能”。文章由此讨论 AI 服务推理框架（serving harness）的设计思路，强调其需要面向长期演进。
items.summary_en: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift. For the past several years, much of the AI conversation has centered on model capability: bigger models, better reasoning, larger context windows, higher benchmark scores. Those advances have been extraordinary. But as AI moves from experimentation to production, the question facing enterprise leaders has changed—it’s no longer, “what can the model do?”—it’s now, “Can we deliver that intelligence reliably, economically, and at scale?” Increas…
items.why_zh: 当 AI 进入生产环境，推理服务框架的工程质量往往比模型选型更决定成败。
items.why_en: In production, the engineering of the serving harness often matters more to success than which model is chosen.

items.title_zh: Meta重新启用Muse分享功能
items.title_en: Meta turns Muse sharing back on
items.summary_zh: Meta已重新启用Muse的对话分享功能。此前安全研究人员发现，Muse共享对话的公开链接很容易被找到，甚至能检索到营销公司内部营收评估和小企业主贷款申请等页面。Claroc本周早些时候指出，这些共享对话的网址以对话标题命名并写入公共DNS；Ars Technica称Meta在被询问后暂停了该功能，随后Meta在X发帖宣布恢复。
items.summary_en: Meta has re-enabled Muse sharing after security researchers had reported that public conversation links could be easy to find. The researchers said they had been able to find Muse pages like a marketing company's internal revenue review and a small business owner's loan application. Researchers at Claroc reported earlier this week that Muse the web addresses for shared conversations from Muse were named after a conversation's title and written into public DNS. Ars Technica said Tuesday that Meta paused the sharing feature after it reached out about what was going on. In a post today on X, Meta…
items.why_zh: 事件凸显AI对话分享功能中的隐私与链接可发现性风险，平台需在便利与安全间取得平衡。
items.why_en: The episode highlights privacy and link-discoverability risks in AI conversation sharing, forcing platforms to balance convenience and safety.

items.title_zh: 好吧，把SpaceX和特斯拉合并，谁在乎
items.title_en: Sure, let’s smoosh SpaceX and Tesla together, who cares
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉与SpaceX已成立特别委员会，讨论潜在合并事宜。文章指出，SpaceX因计划再借400亿美元用于购买Nvidia芯片而信用风险较高，但合并讨论仍在推进。作者认为，这笔合并是否具有吸引力，很大程度上取决于人们是否相信马斯克关于前往火星、“传播意识之光”的愿景。
items.summary_en: Mars not depicted. | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images Oh sure, SpaceX's credit risk is pretty high because it's about to borrow another $40 billion to spend on Nvidia chips , but who cares about that? SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss a merger! The degree to which you find this merger compelling likely has to do with the degree to which you believe Elon Musk about wanting to go to Mars, or "spread the light of consciousness," as he put it in this week's SpaceX earnings call (and earlier S-1). Now, a reasonably informed person knows that we don't have the…
items.why_zh: 马斯克旗下两大公司的潜在合并涉及治理、融资风险与战略优先级，值得关注。
items.why_en: A potential merger of two major Musk-led companies raises governance, financing-risk and strategic-focus questions.

items.title_zh: AI ad mocks Talarico as Bible-defacing radical. Democrats bet it will backfire.
items.title_en: AI ad mocks Talarico as Bible-defacing radical. Democrats bet it will backfire.
items.summary_zh: AI ad mocks Talarico as Bible-defacing radical. Democrats bet it will backfire. The Washington Post
items.summary_en: An AI-generated ad portrays Talarico as a Bible-defacing radical, and Democrats are betting the attack will backfire, according to The Washington Post. The episode highlights the growing use of AI-generated content in negative political advertising.
items.why_zh: AI生成政治广告加剧了选举中的虚假信息和攻击性内容争议。
items.why_en: AI-generated political ads intensify concerns over misinformation and attack content in elections.

items.title_zh: 市议员与AI工程师将主持小组讨论，聚焦地区数据中心计划
items.title_en: Council member, AI engineer to lead panel discussing data center plans for region
items.summary_zh: 据《查塔努加时报自由新闻报》报道，一名市议员和一名AI工程师将主持一场小组讨论，聚焦该地区的数据中心计划。报道未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: Council member, AI engineer to lead panel discussing data center plans for region Chattanooga Times Free Press
items.why_zh: 数据中心扩张涉及能源、土地和社区影响，地方层面的讨论对规划和公众参与很重要。
items.why_en: Data center expansion involves energy, land and community impacts, making local discussion important for planning and public input.

items.title_zh: Suno与Anthropic因Madonna、Johnny Cash歌曲面临近3.4亿美元版权索赔
items.title_en: Suno and Anthropic Face Nearly $340 Million in Copyright Claims Over Songs by Madonna, Johnny Cash
items.summary_zh: Suno和Anthropic正面临近3.4亿美元的版权索赔，涉及Madonna、Johnny Cash的歌曲。该报道来自Law Commentary，显示AI公司与音乐版权方之间的法律争议正在升级。
items.summary_en: Suno and Anthropic Face Nearly $340 Million in Copyright Claims Over Songs by Madonna, Johnny Cash Law Commentary
items.why_zh: AI音乐与模型训练的版权诉讼升级，将影响生成式AI的合法性与许可成本。
items.why_en: Escalating copyright litigation over AI and music will shape the legality and licensing costs of generative AI.

items.title_zh: AI交易主线正从芯片股转向网络安全
items.title_en: The AI Trade Is Shifting From Chip Stocks to Cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: 据Barron's报道，围绕AI的投资交易主题正在从芯片股转向网络安全板块。文章聚焦投资者为何将目光从芯片股转向网络安全股，寻找AI浪潮中的下一阶段受益者。
items.summary_en: The AI Trade Is Shifting From Chip Stocks to Cybersecurity Barron's
items.why_zh: 这显示AI投资逻辑正从算力硬件扩展到安全软件与服务。
items.why_en: It shows AI investment logic expanding from compute hardware to security software and services.

items.title_zh: 读者来信：推迟人工智能的部署
items.title_en: Letter: Delay the deployment of artificial intelligence
items.summary_zh: 《大福克斯先驱报》刊登的一封读者来信呼吁推迟人工智能的部署。来信反映出部分公众对AI快速落地可能带来的风险保持警惕。
items.summary_en: Letter: Delay the deployment of artificial intelligence Grand Forks Herald
items.why_zh: 这体现了关于AI部署速度与风险治理的持续公共讨论。
items.why_en: It reflects the ongoing public debate over AI deployment speed and risk governance.

items.title_zh: 得克萨斯橄榄球队求助AI，随后出现一次尴尬的四档进攻
items.title_en: Texas football turned to AI. Then came one very awkward fourth down
items.summary_zh: 得克萨斯橄榄球队转向AI，随后出现了一次非常尴尬的第四档进攻。报道以此讨论AI进入临场战术决策后可能遇到的现实问题。
items.summary_en: Texas football turned to AI. Then came one very awkward fourth down USA Today
items.why_zh: 这展示了AI进入体育战术决策的实践与局限。
items.why_en: It illustrates both the promise and limits of AI in live sports tactical decisions.

items.title_zh: 三名被解雇的 OpenAI 安全研究员称从未被告知自己泄露了什么
items.title_en: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
items.summary_zh: 据 The Decoder 报道，三名被 OpenAI 解雇的安全研究员表示，他们至今未被告知自己究竟泄露了什么。报道聚焦解雇与泄密指控中的信息不透明问题：当事人对指控的具体内容提出疑问，而外界也无法从现有信息中确认所谓泄露的范围。事件再次把 AI 安全研究、内部举报与企业保密之间的张力推到台前。由于报道未披露更多细节，事件仍有待 OpenAI 或相关方进一步说明。
items.summary_en: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked The Decoder
items.why_zh: 此事凸显 AI 安全团队内部举报与企业管理透明度之间的尖锐矛盾。
items.why_en: It highlights the sharp tension between internal whistleblowing in AI safety teams and corporate transparency.

items.title_zh: Jack Dorsey 新语音 AI 令用户惊艳，也引发反欺诈人士担忧
items.title_en: Jack Dorsey's new voice AI is impressing users and alarming fraud watchers
items.summary_zh: 据 CoinDesk 报道，Jack Dorsey 推出的新语音 AI 既让用户感到惊艳，也引发反欺诈观察人士担忧。报道称，这款语音 AI 的逼真表现获得好评，但同样可能被用于语音伪造等欺诈场景，因此受到风险监测者关注。事件凸显生成式语音技术在体验提升与滥用防范之间的平衡难题。目前报道未给出具体滥用案例或技术细节，围绕该工具的讨论集中在辨识难度与防护措施上。
items.summary_en: Jack Dorsey's new voice AI is impressing users and alarming fraud watchers CoinDesk
items.why_zh: 逼真语音生成越普及，语音伪造与身份欺诈的防范压力就越大。
items.why_en: As realistic voice generation spreads, the pressure to prevent voice spoofing and identity fraud grows.

items.title_zh: 《经济学人》：AI 模型或许并没有那么不透明
items.title_en: AI models may not be so opaque after all
items.summary_zh: 《经济学人》文章讨论 AI 模型是否真的如此难以理解，并指出新研究显示模型或许并非完全“黑箱”。报道认为，随着可解释性研究推进，人们能够以更高层次理解模型内部表征与行为规律。这一进展对 AI 安全评估、监管审计和模型可信度建设都有潜在意义。不过，文章并未宣称模型已完全透明。
items.summary_en: AI models may not be so opaque after all The Economist
items.why_zh: 若模型可解释性提升，AI 安全评估与监管审计将获得更可靠的基础。
items.why_en: Better interpretability could give AI safety evaluation and regulatory audits a more reliable foundation.

items.title_zh: Johns Hopkins alerts 3,000+ patients after data sent to AI tool
items.title_en: Johns Hopkins notifies 3,000+ patients after data sent to AI tool
items.summary_zh: Johns Hopkins alerts 3,000+ patients after data sent to AI tool WMAR 2 News Baltimore
items.summary_en: Johns Hopkins has notified more than 3,000 patients after their data was sent to an AI tool, according to WMAR 2 News Baltimore. The incident raises privacy concerns about medical data entering AI systems. It underscores the need for stronger data governance, vendor management, and patient communication when healthcare organizations adopt AI tools.
items.why_zh: 医疗数据进入 AI 工具后的隐私与合规风险，正成为医疗机构采用 AI 时必须直面的现实问题。
items.why_en: Privacy and compliance risks around medical data in AI tools are becoming a real issue healthcare providers must confront.

items.title_zh: Yonkers Times 列出 10 家最佳医疗 AI 开发公司
items.title_en: 10 Best Healthcare AI Development Companies for AI-Powered Solutions
items.summary_zh: Yonkers Times 刊文列出 10 家面向 AI 驱动解决方案的医疗 AI 开发公司，供有需求的机构参考。文章以榜单形式介绍这些公司，聚焦其在医疗场景中的 AI 开发能力与服务。此类内容反映出医疗 AI 供应商市场持续升温。但榜单的评选标准与独立性在标题中并未说明，阅读时需结合原文审慎判断。
items.summary_en: 10 Best Healthcare AI Development Companies for AI-Powered Solutions Yonkers Times
items.why_zh: 榜单反映医疗 AI 采购需求升温，但推荐类内容也需警惕商业推广属性。
items.why_en: The list reflects rising demand for healthcare AI, while also warranting caution about promotional intent in such recommendations.

items.title_zh: 莫桑比克 INTIC 推动网络安全意识与负责任使用 AI
items.title_en: Mozambique’s INTIC promotes cybersecurity awareness and responsible use of artificial intelligence
items.summary_zh: 据 Tech Review Africa 报道，莫桑比克 INTIC 正在推动网络安全意识，并倡导负责任地使用人工智能。报道称，该机构把 AI 使用与网络安全议题结合，强调提升公众认知和规范应用。此举反映出非洲国家在 AI 快速普及背景下，正加强能力建设与治理宣传。报道未披露具体活动安排或政策细节。
items.summary_en: Mozambique’s INTIC promotes cybersecurity awareness and responsible use of artificial intelligence Tech Review Africa
items.why_zh: 在 AI 快速普及的背景下，非洲国家正通过机构宣传加强网络安全与负责任使用意识。
items.why_en: As AI spreads rapidly, African institutions are using awareness campaigns to strengthen cybersecurity and responsible-use practices.

items.title_zh: JBL CLIPS 琉璃扣耳夹耳机新增“碧玺红色特别版”，1346 元
items.title_en: JBL CLIPS ear-clip earbuds gain Tourmaline Red Special Edition at ¥1,346
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，JBL 现已为旗下 JBL CLIPS 琉璃扣耳夹耳机新增“碧玺红色特别版”，首发价 1346 元，部分地区国补后低至 949 元。 京东 JBL CLIPS 琉璃扣“碧玺红色特别版” 1346 元 点此访问 这款耳机的充电盒、本体均采用半透明设计；搭载 11mm 动圈单元，定制驱动单元加载镀钛双层振膜；支持 SonicArc 定向投送技术，可减少漏音现象，保护用户隐私。 这款耳机支持 IP54 级防尘防水；单体重量 6.5g，采用 C 形桥设计，外部为柔性 TPU 材质，适配多种耳形；内置 4 个麦克风，支持 AI 通话降噪及 ENC 算法，支持使用 App 校正麦克风；配合充电盒使用时续航达 24 小时，单体续航为 8 小时。 IT之家附该耳机详细参数如下： 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 1 次： 点此抽红包 。
items.summary_en: JBL has launched a Tourmaline Red Special Edition of its CLIPS ear-clip earbuds, priced at 1,346 yuan in China, with some regional subsidies bringing it as low as 949 yuan. The semi-transparent model features an 11mm dynamic driver, SonicArc directional audio, IP54 dust and water resistance, and four microphones with AI call noise reduction. Battery life is rated at 8 hours per bud and up to 24 hours with the charging case.
items.why_zh: AI 通话降噪正成为消费级耳机的重要差异化卖点。
items.why_en: AI call noise reduction is becoming a key differentiator in consumer earbuds.

items.title_zh: Cardinal Radcliffe: In age of AI, encourage young people to ask questions
items.title_en: Cardinal Radcliffe: In the age of AI, encourage young people to ask questions
items.summary_zh: Cardinal Radcliffe: In age of AI, encourage young people to ask questions Vatican News
items.summary_en: Vatican News reports that Cardinal Radcliffe said young people should be encouraged to ask questions in the age of AI. The remarks link artificial intelligence with youth education, critical thinking, and pastoral care. The report highlights religious attention to how AI shapes young people’s development.
items.why_zh: 宗教领袖介入 AI 讨论，表明技术对青年教育与价值观的影响正受到更广泛关注。
items.why_en: Religious leaders joining the AI debate shows growing concern about technology’s impact on youth education and values.

items.title_zh: 让 AI 图像适配网页：格式、尺寸与 srcset 的正确做法
items.title_en: Web-Ready AI Images: Formats, Sizes, and srcset Done Right
items.summary_zh: SitePoint 文章讨论如何让 AI 生成的图像真正适配网页使用，重点涉及图像格式、尺寸选择以及响应式 srcset 的正确配置。文章强调，应根据不同屏幕和加载场景提供合适尺寸与格式，以在画质和性能之间取得平衡。文章属于实操型指南，提醒开发者不要只关注生成效果，也要重视前端交付环节。对于在网站中大量使用 AI 图像的开发者而言，这些优化细节直接影响页面加载速度和用户体验。
items.summary_en: Web-Ready AI Images: Formats, Sizes, and srcset Done Right SitePoint
items.why_zh: AI 图像在网页中越来越常见，正确的格式、尺寸和 srcset 配置直接影响加载性能与用户体验。
items.why_en: As AI images become common on websites, correct formats, sizes and srcset settings directly affect loading performance and user experience.

items.title_zh: 给 AI 改名并不能减轻它对写作者的威胁
items.title_en: Renaming AI doesn’t make it any less of a threat to writers like me
items.summary_zh: 《西雅图时报》刊发的一篇评论文章从写作者视角指出，给 AI 改名或换一种说法，并不会削弱它对写作从业者的实际威胁。作者认为，围绕 AI 的命名和包装可能转移讨论焦点，但无法改变创作者面临的竞争与生计压力。文章呼吁正视 AI 对写作行业的深层影响，而不是停留在概念层面的修辞。
items.summary_en: Renaming AI doesn’t make it any less of a threat to writers like me The Seattle Times
items.why_zh: 文章反映了写作者对生成式 AI 冲击职业空间和生计的担忧，以及围绕 AI 命名的公共讨论问题。
items.why_en: The piece reflects writers’ concerns about generative AI’s impact on their work and livelihoods, and the public debate around how AI is named.

items.title_zh: 华盛顿州学校 AI 政策仍停留在 2010 年代，无法为学生未来做准备
items.title_en: WA school AI policies are stuck in the 2010s, not prepping us for tomorrow | Op-Ed
items.summary_zh: 《西雅图时报》评论文章批评华盛顿州学校的 AI 政策仍停留在 2010 年代，未能为学生适应未来做好准备。文章认为，学校对 AI 的应对思路已经滞后，需要更新政策以回应当下和未来的技术环境。标题和摘要未展开具体政策条款，但核心诉求是让教育体系更主动地面对 AI 带来的变化。
items.summary_en: WA school AI policies are stuck in the 2010s, not prepping us for tomorrow | Op-Ed The Seattle Times
items.why_zh: 教育政策若跟不上 AI 发展，会影响学生应对未来技术环境的能力。
items.why_en: If education policies fail to keep pace with AI, students may be less prepared for a technology-shaped future.

items.title_zh: 被迫二选一时，Grok 模型选共和党，OpenAI 模型选民主党
items.title_en: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
items.summary_zh: TechCrunch 报道称，在一项被迫二选一的政治倾向测试中，Grok 的 AI 模型选择共和党，而 OpenAI 的模型选择民主党。报道将焦点放在不同模型在政治选项上的差异，引发外界对 AI 模型政治偏向、训练数据和价值对齐的关注。标题未披露测试方法和完整结果，但结果本身足以提醒人们：模型输出可能带有倾向性。
items.summary_en: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats. TechCrunch
items.why_zh: 不同模型在政治二选一中的差异，凸显 AI 中立性与价值对齐问题的重要性。
items.why_en: The divergence between models on a forced political choice highlights concerns about AI neutrality and value alignment.

items.title_zh: AIIG赴纽约参加人工智能国际会议和学术交流活动
items.title_en: AIIG Attends International AI Conference and Academic Exchange in New York
items.summary_zh: AIIG赴纽约参加人工智能国际会议和学术交流活动 智源社区
items.summary_en: According to BAAI Community, AIIG traveled to New York to attend an international AI conference and academic exchange activities. The available information focuses on participation and exchange, without details on agenda, participants or outcomes.
items.why_zh: 该动态体现了相关团队参与国际人工智能学术交流、了解前沿进展的动向。
items.why_en: The news reflects the team’s engagement in international AI academic exchange and its effort to follow frontier developments.

items.title_zh: AI 数据中心领域挫折不断增多
items.title_en: Setbacks Mounting On The AI Data Center Front
items.summary_zh: Seeking Alpha 文章指出，AI 数据中心领域正出现越来越多挫折，标题聚焦这一正在累积的阻力。公开摘要未说明具体项目、受挫原因或财务影响，但这一趋势与 AI 算力基础设施建设密切相关。若挫折持续，可能影响数据中心扩张节奏和相关产业链预期。
items.summary_en: Setbacks Mounting On The AI Data Center Front Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: 数据中心是 AI 算力扩张的关键基础设施，建设受挫可能影响 AI 产业发展节奏。
items.why_en: Data centers are critical to AI computing expansion, so setbacks could affect the pace of AI infrastructure development.

items.title_zh: 中国经济时报｜梁正：要处理好AI治理与技术进步之间的配速
items.title_en: Liang Zheng: Balance the Pace of AI Governance and Technological Progress
items.summary_zh: 中国经济时报｜梁正：要处理好AI治理与技术进步之间的配速 智源社区
items.summary_en: In China Economic Times, Liang Zheng argues that the pace of AI governance must be balanced with technological progress. The core point is that governance should align with how technology develops, rather than ignoring risks or departing from technical realities.
items.why_zh: AI 治理节奏如何与技术创新协调，是影响风险防控和产业发展的关键问题。
items.why_en: How AI governance keeps pace with innovation is key to balancing risk control and industry development.

items.title_zh: 中国信通院：国内词元服务每秒吞吐量较2025年翻倍，仍低于国外
items.title_en: CAICT: Domestic Token Service Throughput Doubles vs. 2025, Still Below Overseas Levels
items.summary_zh: 中国信通院：国内词元服务每秒吞吐量较2025年翻倍，仍低于国外 搜狐网
items.summary_en: CAICT says domestic token service throughput has doubled compared with 2025 but remains below overseas levels. The comparison points to progress in domestic token service performance as well as a remaining gap with international levels.
items.why_zh: 词元服务吞吐量关系到大模型推理效率与成本，是观察 AI 服务能力的重要指标。
items.why_en: Token service throughput affects large-model inference efficiency and cost, making it an important indicator of AI service capability.

items.title_zh: AI让初级专利律师立刻变强，却可能悄悄阻碍其职业成长
items.title_en: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
items.summary_zh: The Decoder 报道称，AI 工具能立即提升初级专利律师的工作表现，但长期来看可能抑制其专业能力的养成。文章聚焦短期效率提升与长期判断力、经验积累之间的矛盾，提醒法律行业在采用 AI 时兼顾培训与职业成长。摘要未披露具体案例或数据。
items.summary_en: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth The Decoder
items.why_zh: 它提示专业服务行业在享受AI效率红利时，也要警惕对新人培养和独立判断力的长期侵蚀。
items.why_en: It highlights the risk that AI efficiency gains in professional services may come at the cost of long-term training and independent judgment for junior staff.

items.title_zh: Anthropic因使用Elvis Presley音乐训练AI被起诉
items.title_en: Anthropic Sued For Stealing Elvis Presley Music to Train AI: ‘Deeply Protective of These Iconic Songs’
items.summary_zh: 据 Billboard 报道，Anthropic 因涉嫌使用 Elvis Presley 的音乐训练 AI 而被起诉，相关权利方表示对这些标志性歌曲“极力保护”。这起案件再次凸显生成式 AI 训练数据所面临的版权合规争议。摘要未披露具体索赔金额、涉案作品范围等细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Sued For Stealing Elvis Presley Music to Train AI: ‘Deeply Protective of These Iconic Songs’ Billboard
items.why_zh: 它再次表明，AI训练数据的版权授权问题仍是生成式AI公司面临的核心法律风险之一。
items.why_en: It underscores that copyright licensing for AI training data remains a major legal risk for generative AI companies.

items.title_zh: 惠普星 Book Air 14 上架预约：酷睿 5 320、薯条标，国补价 4504.15 元
items.title_en: HP Star Book Air 14 listed: Core 5 320, OLED touchscreen, about ¥4,504 after subsidy
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 24 日消息，惠普京东自营店新上架了一款星 Book Air 14 轻薄本电脑，提供星空蓝、烟灰银、牡丹粉、哈密瓜绿四种配色，京东首发价 5299 元，叠加国补后约为 4504.15 元。 京东 惠普 HP 星 Book Air 14 轻薄笔记本电脑 酷睿 5 16G 512G OLED 触屏 烟灰银 券后 5298 元 领 500 元券 这款机型貌似对应海外的 OmniBook 5 14，搭载英特尔酷睿 5 320 处理器，配备 16GB 内存 + 512GB 固态硬盘，海外版起售价 699.99 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,679 元人民币） 。 该机采用铝合金机身，厚 11.77mm，重 1.16kg，支持 180° 开合，采用 1920*1200 分辨率的 OLED 屏（十点触控），通过 TÜV 硬件低蓝光认证及 HP eye ease 护眼认证。 其他方面，该机内置 60 瓦时电池，续航约 42.5 小时，提供 2 个全功能 USB-C 及 HDMI 2.1 接口，拥有 FHD IR 摄像头、双麦克风，支持 Windows Hello，音频系统由 Poly 调校并得到 DTS:X Ultra 认证。 京东 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，每天抽 3 次： 点此抽红包 。 淘宝 11.11 无门槛红包 面额至高 26888 元，…
items.summary_en: HP has listed the Star Book Air 14 in China with four color options, a Core 5 320 processor, 16GB RAM and 512GB storage. It features a 1920×1200 OLED touchscreen, weighs 1.16kg, and is priced at ¥5,299 before a national subsidy brings it to about ¥4,504.15.
items.why_zh: 它反映出主流轻薄本正以OLED触控屏和补贴后价格争夺注重性价比的消费者。
items.why_en: It shows how mainstream thin-and-light laptops are competing on OLED touchscreens and subsidized pricing for value-conscious buyers.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 第三季度改变我的 AI 投资论点（上调评级）
items.title_en: SpaceX Q3 Just Changed My AI Thesis (Upgrade) (NASDAQ:SPCX)
items.summary_zh: Seeking Alpha 文章称，SpaceX 第三季度的表现改变了作者对 AI 的投资论点，并据此给出上调评级。文章将 SpaceX 的季度进展与 AI 投资逻辑联系起来。摘要未提供具体财务数据或完整的上调理由。
items.summary_en: SpaceX Q3 Just Changed My AI Thesis (Upgrade) (NASDAQ:SPCX) Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: 它显示部分投资者正把SpaceX的季度表现纳入更广泛的AI投资框架，值得关注航天与AI叙事的交叉。
items.why_en: It shows some investors are folding SpaceX's quarterly performance into a broader AI investment framework, highlighting the overlap between space and AI narratives.
